title: Debug packet quarantine boundary not implemented
description: Debug packet quarantine boundary is not yet implemented. Debug-type telemetry packets should be quarantined separately from production telemetry to prevent accidental export. This is a post-RC concern because RC-level operation does not trigger debug packet generation in production flows.
deferral_reason: Debug packets are opt-in and only generated in development mode. Production RC path does not trigger debug packet emission. Implementation scope is well-understood and can follow RC without architectural change.

title: Digestion pipeline is design-only
description: The digestion pipeline exists as a design specification but has no production Digester class implementation. Context digestion is in design phase only. This is deferred to post-RC because single-session RC operation does not require multi-agent context digestion.
deferral_reason: Single-session RC does not require multi-agent context digestion. The Digester design is complete and implementation can follow without architectural risk. No RC gates depend on digestion.

title: Context cache is design-only
description: Context cache is design-only with no production cache store implementation. Session-local caching works but cross-session caching requires a store backend. Deferred to post-RC because RC operates within a single session and does not need cross-session cache retrieval.
deferral_reason: Single-session RC does not require cross-session cache. The cache design is complete and store backends can be added incrementally. No RC gates depend on cross-session cache.

title: 92+ Markdown audit files need migration
description: 92 or more Markdown files in docs/audits/ and docs/reports/ need migration to structured JSON artifacts as required by the documentation policy. These files predate the canonical-JSON-artifacts policy and must be migrated per the rules in AGENTS.md, including migration manifest entries and reference updates.
deferral_reason: Migration is a bulk wave operation that does not block RC functionality. Markdown audit content is informational, not functional. Migration can proceed incrementally post-RC without risk to release stability.

title: Watchable coordination backends not implemented
description: Watchable coordination backends are not yet implemented. The coordination store currently supports file-backed local operation only. Watchable backends (inotify, polling watchers, evented backends) are deferred to post-RC because RC operates in a single-machine single-session model.
deferral_reason: RC operates in a single-machine single-session model that does not require watchable backends. Implementation scope is well-defined and can be added incrementally without architectural change.
